ConnectedApp.label: Hanzo AI
ConnectedApp.description: Hanzo AI for Salesforce — the assistant panel and its API access to api.hanzo.ai. This Connected App governs OAuth for any programmatic access (e.g. an external orchestrator calling into this org, or the org calling out under a named user). The model callout itself uses the Hanzo_API Named Credential; this app is for OAuth-scoped access to Salesforce.
